# Nationwide Haul RV & Bus Repair

> Full Service RV Repair Center and commercial bus repair shop in Lakeland, Florida (Polk County, Central Florida, on I-4 between Tampa and Orlando). One shop services both the chassis (engine, transmission, brakes and air systems, suspension, Hunter alignment, diesel pushers) and the living space (roof, slide-outs, leveling, AC and appliances, water and plumbing, electrical, generators), plus school buses, church and shuttle buses, commercial coaches, DOT inspections, fleet preventive maintenance and 24/7 RV roadside assistance.

- Address: 5021 Frontage Road N, Suite RV, Lakeland, FL 33810
- Phone: 863-434-8893
- Email: lakelandservice@nationwidehaul.com
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM
- Service area: Lakeland, Winter Haven, Plant City, Auburndale, Bartow, Haines City, Davenport, Kissimmee, Tampa, Orlando; Polk, Hillsborough, Osceola and Orange counties
- Credentials: RVDA-RVIA Registered technicians, EPA Universal certified, ASE Master Certified technicians, Florida RV Trade Association (FRVTA) member
- Warranty-friendly: works with RV extended service plans, protection plans and insurance claims; written estimates before work begins
- Google Business Profile: https://g.page/r/CfqSuFqwDXNNECE

## RV and motorhome repair
- [Class A Diesel Pushers](https://nhrvrepair.com/class-a-diesel-pushers.html): Cummins, Freightliner and Spartan chassis service
- [Class C and Gas Motorhomes](https://nhrvrepair.com/class-c-gas-motorhomes.html): Ford E-450, Chevy 4500/6500, Mercedes Sprinter chassis
- [Fifth Wheels and Travel Trailers](https://nhrvrepair.com/fifth-wheel-travel-trailers.html): towable RV repair
- [RV Roof Repair and Sealing](https://nhrvrepair.com/rv-roof-repair.html): EPDM, TPO, fiberglass, leak detection, resealing, replacement
- [Slide-Out and Leveling Systems](https://nhrvrepair.com/slide-out-leveling.html): slide mechanisms, seals, hydraulic and electric leveling
- [RV AC and Appliance Repair](https://nhrvrepair.com/rv-ac-appliance-repair.html): rooftop AC, refrigerators, water heaters, furnaces
- [Water and Plumbing Systems](https://nhrvrepair.com/water-plumbing-systems.html): pumps, tanks, lines, water heaters
- [Electrical Diagnostics](https://nhrvrepair.com/electrical-diagnostics.html): 12V and 120V systems, inverters, converters, batteries
- [Generator Service](https://nhrvrepair.com/generator-service.html): Onan and other RV generators
- [RV Roadside Assistance](https://nhrvrepair.com/rv-roadside-assistance.html): 24/7 mobile support across Central Florida
